subject.title: fix(feishu): drive info finds files past the first page

question: Is the mocked `drive:drive:readonly`-only fallback coverage sufficient to accept the remaining upgrade-compatibility risk and merge this PR?
rationale: The direct metadata path has strong live proof, but no live Feishu app was available with exactly the legacy read-only scope and without metadata permission; accepting that residual gap is a maintainer merge-risk choice.

options.title: Accept the tested fallback
options.body: Merge with the strong live metadata proof and focused mocked legacy fallback coverage.

options.title: Require legacy-scope live proof
options.body: Pause merge until an app with only `drive:drive:readonly` demonstrates successful root-level fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the tested fallback
recommendation.body: Merge with the strong live metadata proof and focused mocked legacy fallback coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the adjacent Drive pagination change and explicitly scoped the remaining info behavior to this canonical issue.
